SELECT po.po_id, po.po_no, po.request_date, po.status,
m.material_code, m.material_name, m.unit, mg.group_name,
pod.requested_qty, hod.qty outboundQty, ho.shipped_at outboundAt,
hod.stock_no ws.expiry_date
FROM place_order po
JOIN place_order_detail pod ON po.po_id = pod.po_id
JOIN material m ON pod.material_code = m.material_code
JOIN material_group mg ON m.material_group_id = mg.material_group_id
LEFT JOIN hq_outbound ho ON ho.po_no = po.po_no
LEFT JOIN hq_outbound_detail hod ON ho.hq_outbound_no = hod.hq_outbound_no
LEFT JOIN warehouse_stock ws ON hod.stock_no = ws.stock_no
WHERE po.status = 'DELIVERED'
ORDER BY po.po_id DESC
